prior_threads.reason: Uriah still knows nothing of the map's history. The party plans to check a marked location on the way to the Barrow, but the treasure is not yet found.

The question is answered: the Clurichen Naggeneen comes into town to drink Quinn's stock (beat_18). He is captured but not destroyed, hanging in a bag behind Quinn's bar with his fate unsettled (beat_22, beat_39).

The hunt changed shape: the party learned the dragon reportedly can't be killed without Brandon's sword (beat_47), that it will soon fly, and that Eric may lack the bounty. Phidipaldi also vowed to bring his lance for George (beat_59).
Shipments still have not come in, and the cause remains unknown.
Not touched this Session; Ned was only seen in the tavern.
Dunk offered 20 gold. Gill will lower the price only once his sons come back, which changes the terms of the purchase.
The thief was caught and revealed as Naggeneen rather than Bentley (beat_21). Quinn paid Phidipaldi, Trout and Uriah 33 gold each (beat_22), so nothing remains owed or unknown.

new_threads.name: Squints and Trout's Halfling Corps
new_threads.reason: Trout recruited Squints on terms that include second pick of the first treasure, which is still owed (beat_42). The party secretly treats him as expendable, and Dirk now reports to him.

new_threads.name: Warwick's mithril chain shirt
new_threads.reason: Dunk wants the glowing magical mithril shirt in Warwick's shop and says he has a plan to get it. He only remarked that it could help against the dragon, so it stands on its own.

new_threads.name: Ingrid's sleeping potion for Warwick
new_threads.reason: Dunk proposed the potion to get himself and Ingrid into Warwick's house (beat_34, beat_35), so it serves the armor plan. He delivered diluted faun wine and the potion is not yet made, so the meeting and his help getting her in are still pending.

new_threads.name: Brandon's sword in the Barrow Mound
new_threads.reason: Father William says the dragon can't be killed without this sword (beat_47), which makes it a child of the dragon hunt. The party is heading to the Barrow, and rescued Brother Dirk wants to go home instead.

new_threads.name: Vivian, the witch in the woods
new_threads.reason: Father William and Ingrid describe Vivian as a witch with ties to Ingrid. Her home is now marked on the map, and the party chose to avoid it, so the question of her stands apart.

new_threads.name: Uriah's penance and donation for Father William
new_threads.reason: Uriah promised to do penance at the Barrow Mound and donate 10 gold for its upkeep, and has done neither yet.

new_threads.name: The man-eating giant in the woods
new_threads.reason: The party stole the giant's intended meal and outran him, but the giant still lives near the route north. Escaping did not end the danger.
